items.title: An expert from the Guardia di Finanza at the Italian Embassy in Riyadh
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 19 LUG - The Italian Embassy in Riyadh has strengthened its structure with the establishment of a Guardia di Finanza Office, headed by Colonel Alessandro Coscarelli in his capacity as an expert from the Corps. The opening of the new office represents an important step in consolidating the partnership between Italy and Saudi Arabia, with the goal of strengthening cooperation in the field of economic and financial security. items.title: University Mission to Dakar for Psychology Education in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 16 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Dakar, Michele Tommasi, met with a delegation from the “G. d’Annunzio” University of Chieti-Pescara, which was on an institutional mission to Senegal as part of the preparation of an Erasmus+ Capacity Building in Higher Education project proposal. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. items.title: Kenya: Ruto Warned Against Underestimating Gachagua
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Former Law Society of Kenya (LSK) President Nelson Havi has warned President William Ruto and leaders of the Broad-Based Government against dismissing Rigathi Gachagua's growing political influence, arguing that the Ol Kalou by-election has demonstrated the former Deputy President's strength in the Mt Kenya region.

items.title: Kenya: UDA Stares At 2027 Reset As Kindiki Signals Rethink After Crushing Ol Kalou Drubbing
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The ruling United Democratic Alliance (UDA) is facing mounting pressure to recalibrate its political strategy ahead of President William Ruto's 2027 re-election bid after suffering a crushing defeat in the Ol Kalou parliamentary by-election, a contest widely viewed as the clearest electoral test yet of the administration's standing in the vote-rich Mt Kenya region.
